source: 758 Devil’s Whispers
target: 758 Susurri Diaboli

source: 758 Devil’s Whispers
target: 758 Susurri Diaboli

source: This really leans towards the concept of harvest…
target: Hoc vere ad notionem messis inclinatur…

source: If I could obtain seeds from magical plants or be in an environment dominated by magical plants and special insects, the Harvest Priest’s combative abilities using mystical means wouldn’t be too bad; they might even be impressively effective…
target: Si semina ex plantis magicis adipisci possem aut in ambitu, quo plantae magicae et insecta specialia dominantur, versari, facultates pugnantium Sacerdotis Messis per modos mysticos non essent pessimae; fortasse etiam mirabiliter efficaces fiebant…

source: The Beyonder ability to directly catalyze plants to unleash their full life force has vast imaginative possibilities.
target: Facultas extramundana, quae plantas directe impellit ad plenam vim vitae eorum liberandam, vastas possibilitates phantasiae praebet.

source: Unfortunately, a Harvest Priest’s direct combat ability is limited.
target: Infeliciter, facultas directa pugnae Sacerdotis Messis limitata est.

source: If Lugano were a Sealed Artifact and I were to use it, things would be completely different…
target: Si Lugano artifactum sigillatum esset et id uterer, res omnino aliter se gerebunt…

source: Amid these thoughts, Lumian looked at Lugano and asked, “Have there been any enhancements to your body?”
target: Inter has cogitationes, Lumian ad Lugano respexit et rogavit: "Num in corpore tuo aliqua melioramenta fuerunt?"

source: "There are some, but not many," Lugano replied honestly.
target: "Nonnulla sunt, sed non multa," respondit Lugano honestē.

source: Lumian nodded and pulled out a letter from his pocket sent along with Hisoka’s Sealed Artifact from Madam Magician, reading it with the aid of the bright white light orb floating above his head.
target: Lumian annuit et epistulam ex sinu suo extraxit, quae cum artifacto sigillato Hisoka a Domina Magician missa erat, auxilio orbis lucentis albae, qui supra caput eius fluitabat, legens.

source: "Temporarily named: Devil’s Whisper.
target: "Ad tempus nominatum: Susurro Diaboli.

source: Positive effects:
target: Beneficia:

source: 1. Devil’s Arm:
target: 1. Bracchium Diaboli:

source: To minimize the negative effects and make it easy to use, the Beyonder ability of this bone ring is reduced.
target: Ut effectus negativos minuantur et usus facilius fiat, facultas extramundana huius anuli ossei diminuitur.

source: Originally Devil Transformation targets the entire body, it now only affects the arm wearing Devil’s Whisper.
target: Initio Transformātiō Diaboli totum corpus inficiebat, nunc solum bracchium, quod Susurro Diaboli gerit, afficit.

source: It causes the arm to swell, darken, and sprout sinister patterns, as if covered with a thick layer of armor.
target: Illud facit ut bracchium tumescat, obscuretur, atque exempla sinistra emergant, quasi crassa lorica tegeret.

source: The flesh becomes highly elastic and resistant, minimizing damage.
target: Caro vehementer elastica et resistentia fit, ita damna minuens.

source: The arm in question becomes immune to most poisons, resistant to curses and fire to a certain degree, and significantly stronger.
target: Id bracchium plurimis venenis immunis fit, maledictis et igne ad certum gradum resistente, ac valde fortius efficitur.

source: 2. Malice Perception:
target: 2. Perceptio Malitiae:

source: For the same reason, Malice Perception granted by this ring only helps you sense whether people around you bear ill will towards you, not to detect looming dangers.
target: Propter eundem rationem, perceptio malitiae a hoc anulo concessa solummodo tibi prodest intuendi an homines circa te malevolentiam gerant, non imminentia pericula detegendi.

source: Make do with it.
target: Suscipe illud.

source: 3. Desire Incarnation:
target: 3. Incarnatio Desiderii:

source: This is a power I specifically requested the Artisan to emphasize, sacrificing the chance to obtain other powerful effects.
target: Haec est vis quam ab Artifice specialiter petivi ut eminere faceretur, renuntians occasione ad alias potentias effectus consequendos.

source: Moreover, to ensure its full manifestation, I agreed to slightly increase the ring's negative effects.
target: Insuper, ad plenam eius manifestationem efficendam, consentivi paulo augere effectus negativos anuli.

source: It can transform your body into a shadowy black liquid composed of various emotions and desires, helping you avoid damage, conceal your movements, and affect your enemies.
target: Potest corpus tuum in liquidum atrum umbratile, ex variis affectibus et cupiditatibus compositum convertere, quod tibi damna vitare, motus celare, et inimicos afficere adiuvat.

source: This sounds quite useful, but is it worth my special request to the Artisan?
target: Hoc videtur satis utile, sed num valet speciali petitioni meae ad Artificem?

source: You’ll understand why once you use it.
target: Intellies cur, simul ut id uteris.

source: Upon reading this, Lumian muttered to himself, ‘So, by suppressing the reduced negative impacts of the first two positive effects, some of the impact has returned in the Desire Incarnation ability? What makes it so special for Madam Magician to do this?’
target: Hoc lectum, Lumian sibi submurmuravit: "Ita, minuendo effectus negativos parvos duorum primorum effectuum positivorum, aliquantum ictus in incantatione Desiderii restitutus est? Quid hoc facit ita speciale ut Domina Magician id efficat?"

source: Lumian didn’t rush to experiment and continued reading.
target: Lumian ad experimenta non festinavit et lectionem continuavit.

source: 4. Wraith Shriek
target: 4. Clamor Umbrae

source: By rubbing the demon relief on the ring’s face and emitting a loud sound, you can create an effect similar to Wraith Shriek that can rupture the eardrums of living beings and harm their spirits.
target: Levando imaginem daemonis in facie anuli et sonum acutum emittens, effectum simile Clamori Umbrae creare potes, quod membrana auralis viventium frangere et animas laedere potest.

source: The closer they are to you, the better the effect.
target: Quo propius tibi adsunt, eo melius effectus est.

source: Negative effects:
target: Effectus negativos:

source: After wearing it, your malice will become more pronounced.
target: Post id gestum, malitia tua magis manifesta fiet.

source: If you can’t control yourself and indulge in malice, you’ll gradually slip into the Abyss and eventually be controlled by the malice of this ring, meaning, if you indulge in malice while wearing it, you will become its puppet, and it will be the driver, you the driven.
target: Si te ipsum regere non potes et in malitiam indulgeas, paulatim in Abyssum lapsurus eris et tandem a malitia huius anuli dominaberis, id est, si dum id geris in malitiam indulgeas, eius mancipulum fies, et ipse moderator erit, tu subiectus eris.

source: While it’s not that a single indulgence in malice will result in being controlled, it’s hard for humans who have tasted the sweet lure of malice not to continue.
target: Cum non sit quod una indulgentia in malitiam statim dominari incipiat, difficile tamen est hominibus, qui dulcedine malitiae gustaverunt, non perseverare.

source: According to my estimates, the conspicuous malice combined with the existing negative effects of the contract ability will negate all your endurance from Ascetic and your own willpower, making you unable to withstand further emotional and desire stimuli.
target: Secundum aestimationem meam, malitia manifesta cum effectibus negativis facultatis contractae totam tolerantiam ex Ascetismo et tuam ipsius voluntatem delebit, efficiendo ut impulsus affectuum et cupiditatum ulteriores ferre non possis.

source: Moreover, whether worn or not, just carrying it will cause your body to suffer burns from sulfur flames, both internally and externally.
target: Praeterea, sive id geris sive non, solum illum portans corpus tuum ex flammis sulfuris, tam internis quam externis, conflagrabit.

source: Placing it in the Traveler’s Bag can effectively mitigate this effect.
target: Illud in sacco viatoris ponere hunc effectum efficaciter mitigare potest.

source: As a Pyromaniac who has reached Sequence 5, you can withstand these burns for a longer period, but be mindful of the sulfur’s toxic effects and treat it promptly.
target: Ut pyromaniacus, qui Sequenciam Quintam attigit, has comburitiones diuturnius ferre potes, sed memento effectuum toxicorum sulfuris et celeriter curare.

source: Furthermore, including yourself, people within a hundred meters radius will be subtly influenced by the Devil’s Whisper, more prone to ill thoughts and impulsive actions.
target: Praeterea, te ipsum includens, homines intra centum metrorum radii subtiliter a Susurro Diaboli influentur, inclinati ad cogitationes malévolas et actus impulsivos.

source: This can also be mitigated by placing it in the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Hoc quoque mitigari potest, si in sacco viatoris reponatur.

source: The rest is okay, but after wearing Devil’s Whisper, my emotions and desires will become my greatest weaknesses…
target: Res cetera bene sunt, sed postquam Susurro Diaboli geretur, affectus et desideria mea maximae infirmitates erunt…

source: Lumian assessed this Sealed Artifact from Hisoka.
target: Lumian hoc artifactum sigillatum a Hisoka aestimavit.

source: Its sealing is relatively simple, requiring only spatial isolation.
target: Eius sigillatio relativam simplicem habet naturam, qua solummodo separatio spatii requiritur.

source: Combined with Lumian’s strong endurance, he could totally use it as a mystical item.
target: Cum robusta tolerantia Lumiani conjuncta, illud omnino uti poterat ut rem mysticam.

source: Lumian then pulled out the pitch-black bone ring, wrapped in a dark transparent barrier, from another pocket.
target: Lumian de altera coscina extraxit anulum osseum nigrum, in obscuro vehiculo translucido involutum.

source: He pressed his hand against the sphere and slowly reached inside.
target: Manum contra sphaeram premens, lente intus pervenit.

source: His right hand felt like it was moving through a dense swamp, struggling to touch the ring.
target: Manus dextra eius videbatur quasi per densam paludem moveretur, luctans anulum attingere.

source: At the same time, the dark sphere silently crumbled, unfolded on its own, and merged with the surrounding void.
target: Simul, sphaera obscura silentio corruens, se ipsa dissipavit, et cum vacuum circumiectum commiscuit.

source: Lumian then slipped Devil’s Whisper onto his left index finger.
target: Lumian deinde Susurro Diaboli in digito indice sinistro induit.

source: His body suddenly liquefied and became ethereal.
target: Corpus eius subito liquefactum est et quasi aethericum evanescens factum est.

source: He turned into a pool of thick black liquid.
target: In stagnum liquoris densi nigri convertebatur.

source: Lugano, who only glanced at him, shivered uncontrollably, chilled to the bone as if he had seen the most sinister and hidden desires and emotions deep within the human heart.
target: Lugano, qui eum tantum inspexit, vehementer tremuit, frigidus ad ossa, quasi vidisset obscurissima et abscondita desideria ac affectus, in profundo corde humano latentia.

source: The newly-advanced Harvest Priest impulsively asked Lumian, who had just returned to human form from a black liquid state, “When can we return to the surface?”
target: Novus et progressus Sacerdos Messis impetuoso animo Lumiano interrogavit, qui modo ex statu liquoris nigri in formam humanam rediit: "Quando ad superficiem redire possumus?"

source: Lumian gave him an icy glance, his blue eyes seemingly harboring a darkness that no light could penetrate.
target: Lumian ei gelidum intuitum dedit, oculis caeruleis quasi tenebras latentibus, quas nullum lumen penetrare posset.

source: Lugano shuddered violently, a familiar fear creeping back as he stuttered, “J-just asking.”
target: Lugano vehementer tremuit, timore noto reveniente, dum balbutiens dixit: "M-Modo quaero."

source: Lumian cracked a slightly mad smile and slowly removed the Devil’s Whisper, placing it back into the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian leviter insanus subridens, Susurro Diaboli lente removebat et in sacco viatoris reponit.

source: He now understood why Madam Magician had specifically requested this ability.
target: Nunc intellexit cur Domina Magician specialiter hanc facultatem postulavisset.

source: His desires and emotions were not entirely his own!
target: Desideria et affectus eius non omnino proprii erant!

source: A smaller part of his emotions and desires stemmed from his fate linked to Termiboros, from the residual aura of the Blood Emperor, and from the bloodline of Omebella.
target: Pars minor affectuum et desideriorum eius orta est ex sorte sua coniuncta cum Termiboros, ex aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis, et ex stirpe Omebellae.

source: Normally, these would only affect him, but using Desire Incarnation, these emotions and desires could be materialized and thus exert some influence on the outside world and his enemies.
target: Normaliter haec solum eum afficerent, sed per Incarnationem Desiderii, affectus et desideria illa materiali fieri possent ac ita extra mundum et adversarios suos influere.

source: If I were to envelop a Sequence 4 Saint in the Desire Incarnation form, that demigod would likely suffer from the corresponding emotional and desire corruption…
target: Si Sainctum Sequenciam Quartam in forma Incarnationis Desiderii complexerero, ille semideus verisimiliter corruptionem affectuum ac cupiditatum correspondens pati fore videbatur…

source: But this method of attack means I’m forgoing evasion to face the backlash head-on, Lumian mused briefly, fairly satisfied with this Sealed Artifact.
target: Sed hoc modus oppugnationis significat me evasionem relinquere ut ictum retributivum directe oppugnem, Lumian breviter meditatus est, satis de hoc artifacto sigillato contentus.

source: Facing a demigod, evasion was sometimes futile—better to fight it out!
target: Oppugnans semideum, evasio interdum frustra fuit—melius est pugnare!

source: And both the Sword of Courage and Devil’s Whisper gave him that chance.
target: Et Gladius Fortitudinis atque Susurro Diaboli illi hanc occasionem dederunt.

source: When night fully descended, Lumian arrived at the headquarters of the Psychic magazine, located at 19 Rue Scheer in Avenue du Boulevard, and met Mr. K in the basement.
target: Cum nox plene descendit, Lumian ad praeses ephemeris Psychicae, sita in 19 Rue Scheer in Avenue du Boulevard, pervenit et Dominum K in subterraneo convenit.

source: Mr. K, wearing a wide hood, warmly said, “Let us pray to the Lord first.”
target: Dominus K, pallio lati indutus, calide dixit: "Primum ad Dominum oramus."

source: Lumian nodded slightly and closed his eyes.
target: Lumian leniter annuit et oculos clausit.

source: His thoughts tightly wrapped, not drifting outward.
target: Cogitationes eius strictissime contentae erant, neque extra se disfluebant.

source: After a while, he and Mr. K opened their eyes simultaneously.
target: Post aliquod tempus, ipse atque Dominus K simul oculos aperuerunt.

source: Mr. K, with a hoarse but fervent voice, said, “Congratulations, you are now a candidate Oracle.”
target: Dominus K, voce rauca sed fervida, dixit: "Gratulamur, nunc candidatus Oraculi es."

source: “This is the greatest reward, being closer to the Lord is the greatest reward for us!”
target: "Id est maximum praemium; propinquitas ad Dominum nobis summum est praemium!"

source: “Afterwards, wherever you go, you can contact the local Oracles or members of the Aurora Order, followers of the Lord, to request their help.”
target: "Postea, ubicumque pergis, poteris contactum habere cum Oraculis localibus aut membris Ordinis Aurorae, Domini fautoribus, ad auxilium petendum."

source: “If there are no Saints or Oracles locally, you have the authority to call upon all resources there, including personnel, money, intelligence, and materials.”
target: "Si Sancti aut Oracula locali non adsunt, auctoritatem habes omnes opes, inter quas sunt homines, pecunia, intelligentia, et materia, evocandi."

source: Is this the Aurora Order’s reward, elevating my authority and status?
target: Num hoc praemium Ordinis Aurorae est, quod auctoritatem ac dignitatem meam extollit?

source: Lumian made the sign of the cross over his chest and said in a hoarse voice, “Praise you for creating all. Praise you for bearing the world’s sins!”
target: Lumian crucem super pectus suum signavit et voce rauca dixit: "Laudo te quod omnia creasti. Laudo te quod peccata mundi sustinuisti!"

source: Mr. K nodded in satisfaction.
target: Dominus K contentus annuit.

source: “There are no other rewards for now, let’s continue to investigate the matter of the vortex.”
target: "Non sunt alia praemia pro tempore; pergamus rem vorticis investigare."

source: "Okay," Lumian quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
target: "Bene," Lumian leniter suspiravit levationis causa.

source: If Mr. K had offered material rewards, he would have hesitated to accept them.
target: Si Dominus K praemia materialia obtulisset, dubitaverit ea accipere.

source: It’s not that he was worried about the items themselves being marked by that entity; after all, he was already under surveillance, so a little more wouldn’t make a difference.
target: Non quidem de ipsis rebus sollicitus erat, ut ab illa entitate notarentur; iam enim sub vigilantia erat, ideo parva amplius non differebant.

source: His reluctance was more psychological.
target: Eius haesitatio magis psychologica fuit.

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and then informed Mr. K, “I might be heading to the Southern Continent again soon to wrap up some previous matters, not sure how long I’ll need.”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus deinde Dominum K certiorem fecit: "Fortasse mox iter faciam ad Continens Meridionalem, ut aliqua negotia praeterita conficiam; nescio quamdiu opus erit."

source: "Alright," Mr. K nodded gently, "Which area specifically?"
target: "Optime," Dominus K leniter annuit, "Quae regio praecipue?"

source: "Not sure yet," Lumian answered truthfully.
target: "Nondum certus," Lumian veraciter respondit.

source: He really didn’t know.
target: Vero nesciebat.

source: Mr. K didn’t inquire further.
target: Dominus K ultra non interrogavit.

source: "We have Saints and Oracles on the Southern Continent, and many followers of the Lord operating secretly there. Once you determine the specific location, I can help you contact the person responsible for that area."
target: "Sanctos et Oracula in Continens Meridionali habemus, atque multos Domini fautores ibi occulte operari. Quoties locum precisum statuas, possum te iuvare, ut contactum habeas cum eo, qui illius regionis curae praefuit."

source: "Thank you, Mr. K," Lumian said, expressing his gratitude.
target: "Gratias tibi, Domine K," Lumian dixit, gratiam suam exprimens.

source: Mr. K corrected him, "No need for thanks; we are all Oracles now, not being equals is disrespectful to the Lord."
target: Dominus K eum corrigens dixit: "Nulla gratia opus est; omnes nunc Oracula sumus, et inaequales esse Dominum contumeliant."

source: Lumian was momentarily speechless.
target: Lumian per momentum mute erat.

source: He casually asked, "Mr. K, that cathedral you took me to last time, does it have any significant meaning within our Aurora Order?"
target: Levis animo interrogavit: "Domine K, illa cathédralis, quam me adduxisti tempore ultimo, num aliquam significationem in Ordine Aurora habet?"

source: Mr. K replied fervently, "That was the first cathedral established by our Aurora Order."
target: Dominus K fervide respondit: "Illa prima cathédralis a nostro Ordine Aurora instituta est."

source: Is it related to Baynfel?
target: Num ad Baynfel pertinet?

source: Lumian asked a few more indirect questions from different angles, then took his leave.
target: Lumian alias quaestiones indirectas ex diversis angulis rogavit, deinde discessit.

source: Returning to Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, he informed Franca and Jenna about the Knight of Swords’ request and then activated the black mark on his right shoulder, beginning the teleportation.
target: Rediens ad Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Francae et Jenna de petitione Equitis Gladii nuntiavit, deinde signum nigrum in umero dextro suo activavit, teleportationem incipiens.

source: He moved between layers of pure color blocks and indescribable bizarre creatures, not knowing how long it took, but he finally arrived at the location indicated in the Knight of Swords’s letter.
target: Inter stratos purorum colorum iugorum et ineffabilia monstrosa animalia migravit, nescientem quantum temporis transierit, sed tandem ad locum indicatum in epistula Equitis Gladii pervenit.

source: The first thing that caught Lumian’s eyes were several pale-faced men and women, like bodyguards, surrounding the Knight of Swords with somewhat disheveled brown hair, a suppressed look in his eyes, dressed in a white shirt and black vest.
target: Primum quod oculi Lumiani incipuerunt erant complura viri et feminae pallide vultu, quasi custodes, qui Equitem Gladii circumfovebantur, comis brunneis aliquantulum laxe, vultu repressa, induti in tunica alba et vestis nigra.
